annotations.title: Get the location track of a hire

description:
Get where one hired worker was on an in-person bounty that requires precise location: the site, the latest position and up to 1,000 recorded positions.
Use for: checking where a worker was during this round of work, when they share a precise location.
Not for: seeing who is on site across a bounty (list_hires).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: get_hire_location_track({"hireId":"a3Fh8kQz1WpL0mNc"})
Errors: location_not_shared, no_location_track; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

hireId.description: The hire id, from list_hires or accept_application.

name: get_hire_location_track

deleteAfterDays.description: Positions are deleted this many days after they are recorded.

from.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

to.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

worker.description: The hired worker. id or name is left out only on an older hire that did not store it.

isTruncated.description: More positions were recorded than points holds.

capturedAt.description: The phone's own time of the position. It can be wrong.

points.description: Recorded positions only, newest first, at most 1,000. Nothing is filled in.

capturedAt.description: The phone's own time of the position. It can be wrong.

sharingEndedAt.description: When the worker stopped sharing a precise location. Left out while sharing is on.
